addition.item: Redirects can now be stored as 4SEO redirect rules. New option "Store the redirects in": Automatic (default) uses 4SEO when it is installed, enabled and its redirects are on, otherwise the Joomla Redirects component as before; or force one of the two.

No double jumps in 4SEO: a redirect rule that already points to the old address of a moved article (an earlier move, or one made by hand) is pointed to the new address; a rule of this plugin that starts from the new address, now a live page again, is switched off; a rule for the old address that the plugin did not create is never changed.

change.item: The update server now lives in the repository of the plugin (github.com/WebG-it/auto-archive). Nothing else changes for people who do not use 4SEO.
Works on Joomla 5.0 and 5.1 too (the queries no longer need the createQuery method of Joomla 5.2).

Description and guides: why it exists. The description shown in System > Extensions (English and Italian) now explains what the plugin is for; the user guides and the README explain why archived articles live in a category of their own. No change in behaviour.

addition.item: First release: the archive automation of Archive Layouts for YOOtheme 1.2.1 as a separate plugin that does not need YOOtheme. An archived article is moved to the archive category you choose; a published article saved or moved (also with Batch) into that category is archived through the Joomla article model; optional 301 redirect from the old address; Force archived is off by default.
On first install it imports the automation settings of Archive Layouts for YOOtheme 1.x and switches that old automation off, so the two never run together.

security.item: Moves need a logged-in user with Edit State on the article (and Create in the archive category by default); articles checked out by another user are skipped; guests and the command line never move articles. Screen messages are generic; details only in the log.
